items.title: Nepal rescuers blast hillside in search of hydropower workers as families wait anxiously
items.description: Rescuers have resorted to explosives as they struggle to reach trapped workers, as the flooding death toll reaches 939.

items.title: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks
items.description: The attack on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz - the first known US strike since late July - has killed two people and injured two others.

items.title: Man arrested after Swiss rave shooting that killed woman
items.description: A 22-year-old Italian woman was killed and several injured at a techno rave in Aarau.

items.title: 'She slipped out of my hand' - children missing after ferry sinks off northern Cyprus
items.description: Ayten and Hayri Bicer's two young children are among 20 missing in an incident that killed eight people.

items.title: US singer D4vd's celebrity lawyers withdraw from murder case
items.description: The singer, 21, will be now represented by a public defender in the murder trial of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. He has pleaded not guilty.

items.title: US Supreme Court clears way for Trump to keep building White House ballroom
items.description: The National Trust for Historic Preservation argued the president did not have authority to proceed with construction.

items.title: Dolly Parton laid to rest alongside husband in Nashville
items.description: A private family funeral is held for the singer who died on Tuesday at the age of 80.

items.title: Ex-congressman George Santos banned from betting platform for life
items.description: The prediction market operator Kalshi says Santos made barred trades and misleading comments that influenced prices.

items.title: Messi retires from international football with 'nothing left to give'
items.description: Argentina great Lionel Messi announces his retirement from international football, saying it was a decision that "hurt" but he understands "the time has come".

items.title: John Galliano exhibition at New York Met cancelled after backlash
items.description: The exhibition faced criticism over the British fashion designer's conviction for making antisemitic remarks in 2011.

items.title: Trump pushes Apple to change 'Lake Ontario' to 'Lake America' on its maps
items.description: The request comes after Google made the switch for US-based users over the weekend. MapQuest, another US map provider, said it will not change the name.

items.title: South African airline defends low-altitude aerial stunt over packed stadium
items.description: Airlink says the manoeuvre with two planes in close formation involved careful and precise planning.

items.title: Company offering reward for safe return of truckload of beer
items.description: Police say a thief presented false documentation at a California distribution centre before driving off with the shipment.

items.title: 'Moonies' church leader jailed for two years over bribery offences
items.description: Han Hak-ja, 83, gave South Korea's former first lady two Chanel bags and a diamond necklace, a court found.

items.title: Two dead and more than a dozen missing after 'terrifying' flash flood hits Grand Canyon
items.description: "It was a beautiful day - and then people were screaming," one hiker tells the BBC, as 14 people are missing.

items.title: Algeria president seeks death penalty for arsonists after deadly forest fires
items.description: President Abdelmadjid Tebboune says he is not ruling out foul play after 100 wildfires were recorded.

items.title: Passengers stranded as strike disrupts flights at Kenya's main airport
items.description: Kenya Airways says the strike has caused delays of more than six hours, with some flights cancelled.

items.title: The jury's options in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial
items.description: Jurors have five options before them as they decide the fate of the former nurse charged with killing her three children.

items.title: From playing Serena Williams on screen to following in her footsteps
items.description: Having played a young Serena Williams on the big screen, teenager Thea Frodin is ready to follow in the American great's footsteps at the US Open.

items.title: How the US-Canada trade war is being felt on both sides of the border
items.description: The US-Canada trade war is being felt on both sides of the border.
